name: Mote
overview: The Scripture uses the imagery of a 'mote,' a small particle, to illustrate the importance of self-examination before judging others. In Matthew 7:3-5 and Luke 6:41-42, Jesus highlights the hypocrisy of noticing a minor fault in a brother while ignoring a much greater fault in oneself, symbolized by a 'beam.' Only by first removing the larger sin in our own lives can we rightly and clearly address the smaller faults in others, emphasizing humility and personal repentance as essential for righteous correction.
